title: Painted Rock Estate Winery
specs: Estate vineyard on 56-acre property with views of Skaha Lake
gap: No pricing or duration for tastings or tours
blurb: Painted Rock Estate Winery crafts ultra-premium, terroir-driven Okanagan wines from their single estate vineyard. Their portfolio includes single-varietal wines and a signature Bordeaux blend. Visitors can explore wines and enjoy tastings at their estate perched atop a 56-acre vineyard with views of Skaha Lake.
extraNote: Tasting room atop 56-acre estate on the eastern bench of Skaha Lake
